description: This file defines the FulfilledPromise class, which implements a fulfilled promise in the GuzzleHttp promise library. It includes methods for handling promise fulfillment, rejection, and state querying.

classes.name: FulfilledPromise
classes.description: A class representing a promise that has already been fulfilled. It provides methods for chaining, waiting, and state inspection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a fulfilled promise with a given value, ensuring the value is not itself a promise.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Handles continuation when the promise is fulfilled, immediately invoking callback if provided.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Handles rejection, delegating to the 'then' method with null onFulfilled callback.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Returns the promise value if unwrapped, otherwise null.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the string 'FULFILLED', indicating the promise state.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Ensures the promise cannot be resolved with a different value once fulfilled.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Throws exception as a fulfilled promise cannot be rejected.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Empty method, as fulfilled promises cannot be canceled.
